hypotheses.A1_natural_rank128_improves: Natural-write rank-128 reduces additional Hybrid-64 KL by at least 25% versus global tensor SVD on every corpus.
hypotheses.A2_natural_rank128_preserves_hybrid: Natural-write rank-128 adds median KL at most 0.005 relative to exact Hybrid-64 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A3_natural_rank64_useful: Natural-write rank-64 adds median KL at most 0.01 relative to exact Hybrid-64 on every corpus.
hypotheses.A4_ood_transfer: The natural-write factorization improves additional KL over global SVD at ranks 64, 128, and 256 on both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.A5_rank128_native_fidelity: Natural-write rank-128 has median native-model KL at most 0.05 on every corpus.
